options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

options.doc_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Station licenses
options.doc:
By logic, you are required to acquire a station license to perform
activities in its proximity (Discover restoration loco points, starting jobs, buying
in shops when applicable). 
 - No licenses: Makes it so that station licenses are not needed (gives you them all)
 - Start with one: Start with at least one at random so you can play the game (except MB)
 - All random: No restriction (WARNING: your first station license can be anywhere)
options.doc_html:
By logic, you are required to acquire a station license to perform

activities in its proximity (Discover restoration loco points, starting jobs, buying in shops when applicable).

  • No licenses: Makes it so that station licenses are not needed (gives you them all)
  • Start with one: Start with at least one at random so you can play the game (except MB)
  • All random: No restriction (WARNING: your first station license can be anywhere)
options.doc_fr:
Par logique, vous êtes tenu d'acquérir une licence de station pour effectuer des activités à proximité (Découvrez les points de restauration loco, les emplois de départ, les achats en magasin le cas échéant).
 - No licenses: Fait pour que les licences de station ne soient pas nécessaires (vous les donne tous)
 - Start with one: Commencez avec au moins un au hasard pour que vous puissiez jouer au jeu (sauf MB)
 - All random: Aucune restriction (WARNING: votre première licence de station peut être n'importe où)

options.name: Demo locos spawn
options.doc:
Choose how demo locos are treated:
- Vanilla: No changes are made to demo locos, one of each loco will randomly spawn in the game
- AP gated: No loco will spawn, instead, 2 "Progressive demo loco" are added in the item pool for each locomotive.
   The first level will directly spawn the corresponding loco on its track in the museum
   The second level allows you to install the parts after having retrieved them from MF
